decision: Do not run more RTNN synthetic timing as paper-reproduction evidence. The next meaningful RTNN work is acquisition/packaging of one exact or honestly bounded paper-family dataset, followed by same-output comparison between author RTNN, RTDL OptiX, and Embree/CPU under the same radius+K contract.
